snippet: T0 Trial (ChunKing): Yield 0. Part stuck in tool due to miscalc shot volume.
T1 Trial (ChunKing): Massive flash from intentional over-pressure. Broken ribs stuck in tool.
T2 Trial: Venting insufficient. Cavity polish insufficient. Proposed 'active' ejection mechanism.
T3 Trial (ShenMing): 46 ABS + 46 HIPS shots. Evaluating material ductility vs brittleness.
T4 Plan: $2500 'Ribs & Rads' investment. Increase rib thickness to 1.5mm.
T4 Result: Consistent fill achieved. Diameter undersize (385.90mm vs 386.65mm).
T5 Result: No dimensional improvement. Samples delivered to Sunnyvale for analysis.
T6-1 Result: Rib fin defects (short shots/voids) persist due to air entrapment.
T6-2 Trial (YungChing): ABORTED. Damaged thermocouples stopped trial.
T7 Trial scheduled with YungChing.
Samples received for pilot inspection.
Documentation of flash condition on 'raw' (non-reworked) sample parts.
Forensic Metrology: Slot 205 ribs measure 1.08mm (spec 0.86mm). Slot width 1.37mm.
Ejector pin pads flagged as 'too high' (Must be 0 +/- 0.1mm).
Rework Procedure: 'Do not force discs.' Use 3 inspection discs to cycle 320 slots.
ECN Rev 11: Corrected tolerance typo (-0.50) and gate numbering schema.
Field Crisis: 'Tight slots' in 200-series causing friction/injection failures.
Missing roller spring retaining clips identified in KRMA returns.
Warpage Inspection REV 1: Criteria set at >1mm vertical deflection.
